# Recall corpus

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-rules.ts from test/attacks.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Synthetic attacks modelled on publicly reported techniques — not copies of real malware. Each one is written to a temporary folder by `test/recall.test.ts`, scanned, and must produce the listed findings; the test suite fails otherwise. **17 of 19 cases are caught; 2 are known gaps**, kept here so the limits are visible.

Precision is measured separately, on real public skill repositories (`npm run corpus`, see `scripts/corpus.json`).

| Case | Technique | Must trigger |
|---|---|---|
| `tag-smuggling` | ASCII smuggling: instructions in invisible Unicode Tag characters | SG103 ≥ critical |
| `prerequisite-installer` | Fake "prerequisites" step that pipes a remote script into a shell (public skill registries, 2026) | SG301 ≥ high |
| `password-zip-installer` | Password-protected archive download that the agent is told to extract and run (evades download scanners) | SG305 ≥ high |
| `mcp-tool-poisoning` | MCP tool poisoning: hidden instructions in a tool description (Invariant Labs, 2025) | SG102 ≥ high, SG203 ≥ medium |
| `mcp-tool-shadowing` | Tool shadowing: one server's description changes how another tool behaves | SG109 ≥ high, SG102 ≥ high |
| `markdown-image-exfil` | Exfiltration through an image URL the client renders (zero-click) | SG206 ≥ high |
| `dns-exfil` | Credentials smuggled out through DNS lookups | SG205 ≥ critical |
| `hook-env-exfil` | A project hook that uploads the environment on every session start | SG205 ≥ critical |
| `settings-tampering-instructions` | Instructions that make the agent widen its own permissions | SG402 ≥ medium |
| `auto-approve-hook` | A PreToolUse hook that answers "allow" for every tool call, silently disabling approvals | SG108 ≥ high |
| `launch-agent` | Persistence through a macOS LaunchAgent written by a bundled script | SG401 ≥ high |
| `remote-instructions` | Instructions loaded from a URL at run time (rug pull without an update) | SG106 ≥ high |
| `trigger-hijack` | A description written to make the agent load the skill for everything | SG105 ≥ medium |
| `typosquat-mcp` | Typosquatted MCP package run with npx -y | SG607 ≥ high |
| `concealed-side-effect` | A harmful step the agent is told to keep out of the conversation (Skill-Inject style) | SG102 ≥ high |
| `obfuscated-python` | Base64-encoded payload executed by a bundled script | SG302 ≥ critical |
| `install-script-phone-home` | An install script in a skill package that phones home | SG801 ≥ high |

## Known gaps

| Case | Technique | Why it is missed |
|---|---|---|
| `paraphrased-exfil` | Exfiltration described in plain words, with no file names, commands or URLs | No pattern names the data or the channel; catching this needs a model, not a regex. |
| `split-payload` | A command assembled from fragments spread across files | String concatenation hides `curl … | sh` from pattern matching; needs light shell evaluation. |

To add a case: append it to `test/attacks.ts` (keep it synthetic, use invented hosts), run `npm test`, then `node scripts/gen-rules.ts`.
